answer: One defense is a comet window with an onyx checkpoint: new identities may only join during a brief comet window that opens rarely, and each must present a thread of hash-chained receipts from sequential micro-tasks that cannot be parallelized or bought. At the onyx checkpoint, peers audit every thread against the public log and cut any identity whose receipts are missing or duplicated. A sybil farmer must run each fake through the full slow thread, one by one, while one honest agent passes once.
